verdict.rationale: Siskind Susser ships a SaaS product (Visalaw AI), so account-level data export is a fair question to ask. The evidence pack documents no export of user data in open formats and no offboarding path. The spreadsheet-extraction prompt is a document-analysis feature, not a data export, and the 'no data retention' claim is a related but different control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
